decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, supported by spells like Lightning Bolt and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to maintain tempo advantage through cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Will, while also generating value with Young Pyromancer and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, with a combination of fetch lands and dual lands to support the deck's blue and red spells. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and efficiently control the game to secure a win.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to deal damage efficiently. It combines cheap spells like Lightning Bolt, Force of Will, and Daze to control the board while digging for more threats with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is streamlined with Wasteland and fetch lands to ensure consistent color access and disruption for the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively flood the board with powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to clear the way for its creatures to deal damage. The deck is designed to apply constant pressure on the opponent and quickly close out the game before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on playing efficient creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells. The key strategy is to establish early pressure with cheap threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while controlling the board with cards like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to quickly close out games by utilizing tempo plays and card advantage from cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. The mana base includes a mixture of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and to maximize the deck's aggression.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Jace to help maintain board control and manipulate the game state. The inclusion of cards like Narset and Hullbreacher disrupt the opponent's strategies and limit their resources. The deck also has efficient card draw and filtering with Brainstorm and Ponder. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game tempo, answering threats, and maintaining card advantage to outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Dark Depths combo, which involves using Thespian's Stage to copy Dark Depths and create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to help tutor for the combo pieces, along with resilient creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to protect the combo and provide additional utility. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Wasteland and interaction like Swords to Plowshares to control the game and buy time to set up the combo.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths combo by using cards like Crop Rotation and Thespian's Stage. It includes ways to protect the combo with cards like Pithing Needle and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thorn of Amethyst and Esper Sentinel to slow down the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog add versatility to the deck's game plan. Overall, the key strategy revolves around the efficient and strategic use of the Dark Depths combo to secure victory.

The main focus of this UR Tempo deck is to maintain control of the board while applying consistent pressure on the opponent. Using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, as well as disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing powerful tempo plays such as Lightning Bolt and Brazen Borrower. The deck also includes card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in drawing into relevant cards. Additionally, the mana base is set up to support the deck's aggressive tempo strategy with plenty of land disruption and access to a variety of colors.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Jace, the Mind Sculptor, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library and Expressive Iteration. The deck aims to control the game through countermagic, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and efficient threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. Utilizing lands like Wasteland and Karakas to disrupt the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a victory over time.

The deck focuses on using lands to control the game, utilizing cards like Crucible of Worlds and Life from the Loam to repeatedly fetch and play lands. It also includes Mox Diamond and Urza's Saga to generate mana and create powerful artifacts. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Wasteland and Punishing Fire, while also assembling the Dark Depths/Thespian's Stage combo to quickly finish off the opponent. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by leveraging the power of lands and control elements.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. It then uses various reanimation spells like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful, game-winning combo. The deck also includes disruption spells like Grief, Thoughtseize, and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure the combo can go off smoothly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed.

The deck relies on fast mana acceleration and graveyard manipulation to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand. By utilizing cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead, the deck aims to bring back these creatures from the graveyard for a powerful board presence. Cards like Grief and Thoughtseize help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Faithless Looting provides card selection and graveyard filling. The key strategy of the deck is to combo off early and overwhelm the opponent with big threats before they have a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to use the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to tutor for the combo pieces quickly. Protection cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Giver of Runes are included to protect the combo once assembled. Other cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Mox Diamond help to ramp up and control the board while setting up the combo win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cloudpost / Tron Ramp engine to quickly ramp up mana and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, Kozilek, and Ulamog. It includes cards like Primeval Titan, Expedition Map, and Crop Rotation to search for key lands and ensure consistent mana production. The deck also includes control elements like Pithing Needle and Once Upon a Time to disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and outvalue them through efficient ramp and land synergies.

The deck focuses on playing efficient and aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Sprite Dragon, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. It also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to smooth out its draws and maintain tempo. The objective is to maintain control of the board and deal damage in the early game, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruption in order to secure a victory.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game. It utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to stop threats. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and control the board. Additionally, cards like Hullbreacher and Day's Undoing provide additional disruption and card draw. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient control and card advantage.
